__comment: estrategia-web-site/consent — «Cookie settings» button that reopens the notice. The notice and all the consent logic live in includes/class-consent.php (its header is the documentation). No editor of its own: supports.autoRegister (WP 7.0). The old name, estrategia-web/consent (parent theme ≤ 0.6.0), is registered by Consent::register_blocks() as a hidden alias.
name: estrategia-web-site/consent
title: Cookie settings link
description: Reopens the cookie consent notice. Renders nothing when the site declares no optional cookie categories.
